name: Central Africa Fibre-Optic Backbone (CAB) CAR Component - National Data Center / Digital Training Center, University of Bangui
developer: Government of Central African Republic / African Development Bank / European Union
notes: AfDB MapAfrica identifies the CAB-CAR component; press coverage of AfDB-financed works in CAR describes the fibre backbone alongside construction of a data center and digital training center at the University of Bangui. ZMS Cable separately summarizes the CAB aim as optical fiber deployment and construction of a national data center. Public sources found in this run did not disclose MW capacity.

name: GreenLine Technologies / SOCATEL Tier III Data Center
developer: GreenLine Technologies Inc. / SOCATEL / Government of Central African Republic
notes: GreenLine's official September 2025 announcement says its SOCATEL mandate includes a new Tier 3 data center and modern connectivity ecosystem backed by an initial $150 million investment. Journal de Bangui reported that on July 16, 2026 authorities launched the operational phase in Bangui, including a Tier III data center; La Tribune / Agence Ecofin reported the same project at EUR 131.5 million. Site-level MW capacity and exact address were not disclosed.

name: Huawei Administration Digital Infrastructure / Tier III Government Data Center
developer: Huawei / Government of Central African Republic
notes: Regional technology press reported a CAR government partnership with Huawei to modernize public administration digital infrastructure, centered on a Tier III data center for government data hosting and secure digital services. Coverage places the government activity in Bangui but did not disclose site address, MW capacity, procurement status, or whether this overlaps with other national data-center efforts.

name: Orange Centrafrique Bangui Data Center / Core Network Facility
notes: Digital Business Africa and Ecofin reported that Orange Centrafrique's data center, core network and radio facilities in Bangui were destroyed by a June 2021 fire, and Ecofin later reported operations resumed after 23 days. Orange's Engage for Change CAR page references a Responsable Data Center, indicating a continuing local data-center function. No public MW capacity was found.

name: Cybastion Institute of Technology Government Data Centers
developer: Cybastion Institute of Technology / Government of Central African Republic
notes: Cybastion's official press release says CAR ministers agreed in April 2021 to implement a series of data centers to be constructed by Cybastion Institute of Technology, launched at an April 29 signing ceremony. The release does not identify individual sites or capacities; Bangui is inferred from the national-government signing context and absence of a more specific division.

name: ECCAS / PIDA PAP2 Central African Republic Data Center
developer: ECCAS / PIDA / Government of Central African Republic
notes: OECD's Africa's Development Dynamics 2025 states that data centers are a priority in the 2019 ECCAS electronic-communications infrastructure master plan, with a USD 92.5 million PIDA PAP2 initiative for six new data centers including one in the Central African Republic. Public material found in this run did not identify a subnational site; Bangui is inferred as the likely national hub.
